changes.problem: Benchmark outputs sometimes omitted source definitions, abbreviations, normative references, and smaller technical details even when the main requirements were retained.
changes.change: Expanded the evidence ledger and source-to-document review to inventory these content classes explicitly and require a recorded scope-based reason for every omission.
changes.reason: Explicit accounting reduces memory-based omissions and improves source fidelity without importing content outside the requested scope.

changes.problem: Some generated specifications introduced unsupported administrative facts, dimensions, deadlines, or sample-derived wording.
changes.change: Added a direct prohibition on copying or inventing locations, dates, deadlines, dimensions, approval data, and other fields unless the supplied sources establish their applicability.
changes.reason: This generalizes the recurring unsupported-addition failure while preserving legitimate source-provided facts.

changes.problem: Unknown values were sometimes marked generically, while information already present in the sources was occasionally replaced by placeholders.
changes.change: Defined strict conditions for gap markers and required each gap to identify the missing decision, its impact, and the affected requirement or verification step.
changes.reason: Precise gap handling prevents placeholders from masking incomplete extraction and makes genuine blockers actionable.

changes.problem: Documents sometimes contained extra title, signature, or service sections and occasionally rendered mandatory forms as simplified prose.
changes.change: Introduced an applicability classification for structural elements and required mandated tables and requisites to retain their prescribed form.
changes.reason: This improves structural compliance while preventing customary or sample-based sections from expanding the requested deliverable.

changes.problem: Verification sections sometimes left source-supported criteria vague or deferred them wholesale to a future test program.
changes.change: Required an internal requirement-to-verification coverage matrix, extraction of every available criterion, and precise blocker records for only the parameters genuinely absent.
changes.reason: This strengthens safety and acceptance coverage without encouraging invented thresholds, equipment, or procedures.

changes.problem: Validation did not make omissions and unsupported document additions equally easy to detect.
changes.change: Separated final validation into source-to-document and document-to-source traceability passes, followed by structural and rendered-artifact checks.
changes.reason: Bidirectional review catches both missing source content and fabricated document content, including formatting residue that semantic review alone can miss.
